item.name: Retrieve WHOIS registration data, CIDR block inventory, and BGP peer relationships for an Autonomous System Number

request.name: Retrieve WHOIS registration data, CIDR block inventory, and BGP peer relationships for an Autonomous System Number

description.content: Returns the WHOIS record for the specified ASN, including organization details, IPv4/IPv6 route objects, upstream/downstream/peer relationships, and both parsed and raw WHOIS text. Accepts the ASN with or without the 'AS' prefix.

query.description: (Required) Autonomous System Number to retrieve WHOIS data for, with or without the 'AS' prefix (e.g. 15169 or AS15169).

response.name: Successful ASN WHOIS response

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

item.name: Search domains by owner name, email, company, or keyword

request.name: Search domains by owner name, email, company, or keyword

description.content: Performs a reverse WHOIS search returning matching domains with registration details. Use mode=default for full WHOIS data or mode=mini for a condensed summary. When mode=default, each item in whois_domains_historical matches the ReverseWhoisDomainDefault schema (full registrar, contacts, name servers, status, and registry data). When mode=mini, each item matches the ReverseWhoisDomainMini schema (domain name, create/update/expiry dates, owner name, email, and company only).

query.description: Keyword to search for in domain names (case-insensitive pattern matching).
Email address to search for in registrant records (case-insensitive exact or regex match; * wildcard supported).
Registrant or owner name to search for (full-text phrase matching).
Organization or company name to search for (full-text phrase matching).
Set to true to return only exact matches for keyword, owner, or company. Default is false.
Response detail level. 'default' returns full WHOIS data per domain; 'mini' returns only key fields.
